proposals.before: When less than one second, leaf-discard is not used; same below.
proposals.after: When less than one second, discard and do not use; the same below.
proposals.reason: Chinese 葉不用 is the calendrical discard formula (likely 棄不用): remainders under one second are thrown away, not 'leaf-discard is not used'.

proposals.before: In all the sagitta obtained is eighty seconds; for the remaining degrees each follows the above method, seeking down to the sagitta, to serve as the root of yellow-and-red mutual seeking and their inner and outer degrees.
proposals.after: In all the sagitta obtained is eighty-two seconds; for the remaining degrees each follows the above method, seeking down to the sagitta, to serve as the root of yellow-and-red mutual seeking and their inner and outer degrees.
proposals.reason: Chinese 八十二秒 is eighty-two seconds; the literal omitted 二 and conflicts with the idiomatic 82″ and the worked example.

proposals.before: Within subtract ecliptic sagitta eighty seconds; remainder sixty degrees eighty-six minutes sixty-eight as small chord of yellow and red paths.
proposals.after: Within subtract ecliptic sagitta eighty-two seconds; remainder sixty degrees eighty-six minutes sixty-eight as small chord of yellow and red paths.
proposals.reason: Chinese 八十二秒 is eighty-two seconds; the literal omitted 二, disagreeing with the idiomatic 82″.

decisions.reason: 不足一秒葉不用 is the calendrical discard formula: remainders under one second are thrown away unused. 'Leaf-discard is not used' misreads 葉 as 'leaf' and reverses the sense; 'discard and do not use' restores the meaning supported by the calculation context and the idiomatic rendering.
矢度八十二秒 is eighty-two seconds; the literal's 'eighty seconds' omits 二 and conflicts with the idiomatic 82″ and the same figure in s0091.
黃道矢八十二秒 is eighty-two seconds; the literal's 'eighty seconds' omits 二 and disagrees with the idiomatic 82″ and the sagitta stated in s0073.
